cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(probe_genex_duplicate_subdir C)

# add_subdirectory() the SAME source dir twice, into two distinct binary
# dirs — a real vendoring pattern (a shared source tree built under two
# configurations / names). cmake lists the source dir twice under the
# parent's SUBDIRECTORIES property, so probe-genex.cmake's recursive
# BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS walk collects the dir's target name twice.
#
# Pre-fix, that duplicate name made the structural probe emit two
# file(GENERATE) calls with the SAME OUTPUT
# (cmake-to-bazel.genex/<tgt>/type.txt). cmake 3.x tolerated the
# identical-content duplicate; cmake 4 rejects it as a hard error
# ("Files to be generated by multiple different commands"), aborting the
# whole configure — so --probe-genex couldn't convert any project using
# this pattern on cmake 4. The fix de-duplicates the collected target
# list before emitting probes.
set(LIBNAME shared_a)
add_subdirectory(shared ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/shared_a)

set(LIBNAME shared_b)
add_subdirectory(shared ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/shared_b)
